relations.text: アルバ・プラントLLCは、LPG処理工場を運営するシェブロンとの合弁事業である
relations.text_en: Alba Plant LLC, which operates an LPG processing plant, is a joint venture with Chevron Corporation

source.label: コノコフィリップス 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: 2 percent interest in the Alba Plant LLC, our joint venture with Chevron Corporation (27.8 percent) and Sociedad Nacional de Gas de Guinea Ecuatorial (SONAGAS) (20 percent), which operates an onshore liquified petroleum gas (LPG) processing plant.

relations.text: メタノール工場を運営するAMPCOの合弁相手で、シェブロンも45%を持つ
relations.text_en: Chevron Corporation holds 45 percent of AMPCO, which operates a methanol plant, alongside ConocoPhillips

source.label: コノコフィリップス 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: We own a 45 percent interest in Atlantic Methanol Production Company LLC (AMPCO), our joint venture with Chevron Corporation (45 percent) and SONAGAS (10 percent), which operates a methanol plant.

source.quote: We own a 56 percent interest in EG LNG, our joint venture with SONAGAS (37.9 percent)

relations.text: APLNGの合弁相手で、上流の生産とパイプラインはオリジンが運営している
relations.text_en: Origin Energy is a joint venture partner in APLNG and operates its upstream production and pipeline system

source.label: コノコフィリップス 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: Origin operates APLNG’s upstream production and pipeline system, and we operate the downstream LNG facility, located on Curtis Island near Gladstone, Queensland, as well as the LNG export sales business.

source.label: コノコフィリップス 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: (APLNG), our joint venture with Origin Energy Limited (Origin) and China Petrochemical Corporation (Sinopec), is focused on producing CBM from the Bowen and Surat basins in Queensland, Australia, to supply the domestic gas market and convert the CBM into LNG for export.
